The Trump administration has announced new tariffs on 14 major trading partners, including India, citing what it describes as structural excess industrial capacity.
The United States has announced a 25% tariff on goods imported from India, in response to India’s “unreasonable acts, policies, and practices” that “burden or restrict U.S. commerce”.
Among the 14 economies targeted by this latest action, India faces the second-highest tariff. Vietnam faces the highest, at 35%.
Thank you for watching our video!
